sections.label: Healthcare capacity expansion
sections.summary: MOH expanded CHAS, set up Family Medicine Clinics and opened hospitals, adding 1,800 beds when fully opened.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In the past few years, MOH has increased the capacity of our healthcare system, in line with our Healthcare 2020 Master Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We expanded the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) to allow about 1.4 million Singaporeans, including our Pioneers, to benefit from subsidised care at private general practitioners (GPs) and dental clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In partnership with the private sector, we established Family Medicine Clinics to care for the increasing number of Singaporeans with chronic diseases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We opened the Changi General Hospital-St Andrew's Community Hospital Integrated Building, Ng Teng Fong General Hospital, Jurong Community Hospital and Yishun Community Hospital, adding a total of 1,800 beds when fully opened.

sections.label: MediShield Life rollout
sections.summary: MediShield Life was rolled out on 1 November 2015, covering all Singaporeans and PRs, including the very old and those with pre-existing conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MediShield Life was rolled out on 1 November 2015, providing better coverage and higher payouts so that patients pay less for large hospital bills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MediShield Life will cover all Singaporeans and PRs, including the very old and those who have pre-existing conditions.

sections.label: MOH 2015 to 2020 plans
sections.summary: From 2015 to 2020, MOH will add beds and community care places, develop a standardised private Integrated Shield Plan and focus on cost-effective care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2020, MOH will continue to add more healthcare facilities to cater to the needs of our ageing population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Within this period, we will add more than 10,000 beds in acute hospitals, community hospitals and nursing homes, as well as more than 7,000 places to community care, home care and palliative home care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Following the introduction of MediShield Life, MOH will work on developing a standardised private Integrated Shield Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: To ensure long-term affordability and sustainability for patients and society, we will also need to focus attention on providing appropriate and cost-effective care, to ensure that new treatments, drugs, devices/implants and medical technology are effective in improving health outcomes.
